label: Time series
desc: Each row in the time series dataset represents a point in time, in units of days indexed from each patient's initial gamma knife radiosurgery. Dataset variables include clinical details related to medication changes, imaging timing/references to raw imaging files, procedure timing, clinical follow up, and outcomes.
rows: Randomly generated 8-digit identifier unique to each patient

Identifies type of visit corresponding to each row/point in time, each with distinct variables related to that event: Medication event is an update to a patient's ordered medications; Gamma Knife indicates a gamma knife procedure; Image corresponds to a Brain MRI; Follow Up corresponds to an office appointment with associated clinical data from that visit; Death reports details related to a patient's death
